rule: Functional bins (64/64) are enforced by the acceptance gate. Line/branch/toggle coverage is measured and reported on every run over the whole cold run (boot and scenario); gaps are recorded corpus limits, not failures. A module instance whose source differs from the recorded baseline may not reach a smaller fraction of its eligible points of any type than the baseline. Structural coverage is measured on the native runtime only: Verilator 5.020 coverage in the pinned container is about 8x slower (~17 s/frame). Docker runs the same seeded corpus uninstrumented for cross-runtime agreement.

exclusions.reason: Generated simulation wrapper counters are harness instrumentation, outside production RTL coverage. Harness behavior has separate FS tests.
Direct absolute mouse stimulus model; its counters do not qualify physical PS/2 or CDC, which remain unsupported.
Simulation cursor model, outside the accepted production component/storage scope; no physical cursor/CDC coverage claimed.
